lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Covenant was sworn under a sky of falling stars. Five lights, five oaths, one promise: that the world would not be left to the Hollow.

lines.speaker: Kaelen Ashvow
lines.text: Thornwick again. Every time the marsh floods, something older than the water comes up with it.

lines.speaker: Seraphi
lines.text: The wardens' lanterns went dark three nights ago. Whatever is out there, it is not afraid of light anymore.

lines.speaker: Kaelen Ashvow
lines.text: Then we remind it. Stay behind me, keep the others standing, and do not let me get clever.

lines.speaker: Seraphi
lines.text: You? Clever? I will try to notice when it happens.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something in the reeds answered with a sound like a drowned bell.
